newsitem.title: USA: Walter sees expansion boosting unit revs.
newsitem.headline: Walter sees expansion boosting unit revs.

text.p: Walter Industries Inc said on Tuesday it plans a $31 million expansion of the South Carolina mill of its JW Aluminum Co unit, a move it expects to boost the unit's revenues 14 percent in fiscal 1998 and by 13 percent annually through 2002.
Walter said in a news release that JW Aluminum's fiscal 1998 revenues should rise to $170 million as a result of this expansion and earlier expansion efforts.
The current expansion effort should increase the mill's capacity 60 percent by May 1999. The move is in response to increased demand for JW Aluminum's specialty products, the company said.
Product shipments during the next five years are expected to increase by 12 percent annually, Walter said.
JW Aluminum's plant is located near Charleston.
Walter Industries is a multisubsidiary company with interests in homebuilding/financing and industrial operations.
